statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of the public age gate and representative public legal/support templates. Porn listing, playback, biometric submission, and authenticated account completion were excluded.

page.notes: The root URL is a jurisdictional age-verification gate. Public legal/support pages remain reachable. The account/verification overlay was opened but no image, biometric, credential, or account data was submitted.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated dark-mode screenshot plus computed CSS inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The UI remains the same hard-coded black theme and the CSS probe found no color-scheme, prefers-color-scheme, or light-dark() support; the only theme switch is a cookie.
The age gate contains an indefinitely repeating SVG <animate>; the only prefers-reduced-motion rule found targets an unrelated view counter, so the age animation continues under reduce.
The terms page remains readable and controls remain visible under forced-colors: active and prefers-contrast: more.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/CSS inspection and age-modal state change
checkOutcomes.evidence: No view-transition CSS or API use was found; the primary gate-to-account state swaps abruptly into a custom overlay.
No scroll-linked animation or parallax was present on the representative templates, so no main-thread scroll animation anti-pattern was observed.
No custom pointermove, swipe, pull, carousel, or other gesture-driven interaction was present on the audited paths; native scrolling remained in control.

checkOutcomes.method: Long-page mobile screenshot and CSS inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The 10,158px terms page provides no scroll progress or scroll-state-aware header behavior; CSS inspection found no scroll-state/container mechanism.
The audited templates expose no tooltip, anchored popover, or edge-positioned menu for which CSS anchor positioning is applicable.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited templates expose no tooltip, anchored popover, or edge-positioned menu for which CSS anchor positioning is applicable.

checkOutcomes.method: Heading hierarchy and modal focus probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Legal pages use a prominent page heading and section headings, and opening the account overlay moves focus into its login input, giving a visible destination after navigation.
The age gate is a legally required access boundary rather than an advertising interstitial; legal content is not obscured on load apart from a shallow dismissible cookie strip.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM primitive and active dismissal probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The account flow uses #EPmodal-overlay custom divs, has no <dialog> or role=dialog, exposes no close/cancel control, and remains open after Escape.
The age gate and legal pages devote most of the viewport to the primary content; navigation chrome is compact rather than dominating the page.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout primitive at 360x800 on three templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home, terms, and contact each reported scrollWidth 360, clientWidth 360, horizontalOverflowPx 0, with a valid viewport meta tag.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS probe across reused navigation/content templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: The CSS probe found no @container or container-type use; reused header and content components depend only on viewport media queries.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse target-size audit and focus/geometry probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile footer links are only 14px high and several header controls are 30x30px; Lighthouse failed target-size while keyboard focus itself remained visible.
The entry page clearly explains the age requirement and gives one prominent verification action; legal/support pages use descriptive H1 headings.

checkOutcomes.method: Primary age-verification walkthrough and post-click DOM inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The verification CTA first opens a registration/sign-in wall with multiple identity providers before the advertised selfie verification step, adding an avoidable account detour to the core flow.

checkOutcomes.method: Modal Escape/close probe and missing-route request
checkOutcomes.evidence: The account overlay cannot be cancelled with Escape and has no close control; an arbitrary missing URL also returns HTTP 200 with the age gate instead of an actionable not-found state.
Home Lighthouse measured LCP 2.95s, outside the good <=2.5s range; contact measured 2.38s and the trace measured 1.87s, so the regression is concentrated on the entry gate.
All three mobile layout captures and both Lighthouse runs reported CLS 0 with no observed layout shifts.

checkOutcomes.method: Trace, layout observers, and Lighthouse TBT
checkOutcomes.evidence: The trace and layout observers found no long tasks, and Lighthouse reported total blocking time 0ms on home and contact.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against live script attributes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home loads parser-blocking jQuery 3.4.1 and ajax3.js without async/defer; Lighthouse attributes 2.16s of home LCP to render delay.
Audited pages transfer 74-93KB of JavaScript and Lighthouse did not report a large unused/duplicate-code opportunity; no third-party script dominates total weight.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audits and DOM probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home logo lacks alt text, contact mobile header links lack accessible names, and the custom account overlay lacks dialog semantics.
The green age-estimation message is #0a910a on #222 at 3.83:1, below the required 4.5:1 for its text size.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse structure audits and dismissal/focus probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: The entry page has no main landmark or H1, its UL directly contains a BR, and the custom modal has no dialog role or keyboard dismissal even though initial button focus is visible.
Legal and support copy is rendered around 12.5px with dense justified paragraphs; the fixed cookie strip overlaps the last visible lines on mobile.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse target-size audit and narrow layout screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: Reflow succeeds and scaling is not disabled, but numerous footer/content links are only 14px high and mobile header controls are 30x30px, below accessible target guidance.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse best-practices run on home and contact
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both Lighthouse runs scored Best Practices 1.00 and reported no console-error or uncaught-exception failure.
Although doctype and UTF-8 are valid, all 2 home images and all 23 contact images omit intrinsic width/height; the entry UL also contains an invalid BR child.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse Best Practices and DOM behavior review
checkOutcomes.evidence: No deprecated-API, paste-prevention, notification/geolocation-on-load, or BFCache issue was surfaced on the representative pages.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered/raw metadata inspection and Lighthouse SEO
checkOutcomes.evidence: The public entry page has a descriptive title but no meta description; Lighthouse failed the meta-description audit.
Representative links use real href values, viewport meta is present, robots.txt allows the public site and declares a sitemap, and contact Lighthouse SEO scored 1.00.

checkOutcomes.method: Canonical/robots/sitemap probe and direct missing-route status request
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage has no canonical URL, and an arbitrary nonexistent URL returns HTTP 200 with the age gate, creating a soft-404/indexing ambiguity despite a valid sitemap.
The contact entity exposes six Open Graph tags and eleven hreflang links; the generic age gate has no rich entity requiring JSON-LD.
HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP only says upgrade-insecure-requests, X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy are absent, and epcolor is neither Secure nor SameSite-protected.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR, tracker and consent DOM probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Self-hosted Piwik analytics loads before choice while the only cookie notice action is [X] and continued use is treated as consent; the modal also loads Google identity iframes.
Camera access is behind explicit verification and Start camera actions, not requested on load; authentication offers several federated providers in addition to password login.
HSTS and SAMEORIGIN framing protection are present, but the CSP has no source restrictions or frame-ancestors, and Referrer-Policy/nosniff are missing.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw/no-JS discoverability comparison plus authored DOM behavior
checkOutcomes.evidence: Core text is server-rendered, but the only age-verification action is an onclick button with no form or href fallback, so the primary flow cannot proceed without JavaScript.
The custom account overlay remains after Escape and offers no close/cancel control, so runtime state can trap users rather than recovering predictably.
The audited product is an intrinsically network-dependent streaming service, not an installable/offline app; no offline product intent was declared.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited product is an intrinsically network-dependent streaming service, not an installable/offline app; no offline product intent was declared.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct request and DOM/screenshot of a random missing route
checkOutcomes.evidence: A nonexistent route returns HTTP 200 and the normal age gate, with no not-found explanation, back link, search, or recovery state.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/CSS probe across entry and localized template
checkOutcomes.evidence: Legal pages declare lang=en and expose hreflang, but the entry page has no lang or dir and CSS contains no logical-property strategy.
The representative gate, legal and support pages display no dates, currencies, localized numbers, durations, or calendars requiring locale-aware formatting.
checkOutcomes.reason: The representative gate, legal and support pages display no dates, currencies, localized numbers, durations, or calendars requiring locale-aware formatting.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The representative paths contain no events, schedules, stored times, or recurring time concepts for which time-zone/DST handling applies.
checkOutcomes.reason: The representative paths contain no events, schedules, stored times, or recurring time concepts for which time-zone/DST handling applies.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The gate promises a simple AI verification but first opens registration/sign-in and only later reveals live-selfie/AgeGo options; the cookie notice equates continued use with consent and offers no reject/settings choice.
The camera flow contains role=status, role=alert, aria-live messaging, Retry and Stop camera controls, plus a detailed camera-access help disclosure.
Login and password fields omit appropriate autocomplete tokens, and the focused login input is explicitly autocomplete=off, obstructing password-manager/autofill assistance.
Account registration is inserted before verification and the resulting overlay has no close control or Escape dismissal, making the commitment neither clear nor easily reversible.

checkOutcomes.method: Image inventory and HAR weight analysis
checkOutcomes.evidence: The entry spends 169KB on a JPEG background, retains a legacy GIF badge, and contact loads legacy JPEG thumbnails; image elements lack intrinsic dimensions and responsive source selection.
The contact page fetches multiple adult gallery thumbnails that render at 0x0 on the support template, while analytics also starts before a user choice.
The audited static paths transfer 202-284KB, autoplay no media, and contact uses a self-hosted analytics endpoint; overall media/script weight is modest for the product.

No developer intent or user journey indicates that this age-gated media site should expose transactional WebMCP capabilities; its public static content is already server-rendered and it exposes a conventional webmaster API.
checkOutcomes.reason: No developer intent or user journey indicates that this age-gated media site should expose transactional WebMCP capabilities; its public static content is already server-rendered and it exposes a conventional webmaster API.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation, writing, classification, or other user task on the audited gate/legal/support paths would clearly benefit from built-in on-device inference.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation, writing, classification, or other user task on the audited gate/legal/support paths would clearly benefit from built-in on-device inference.

checkOutcomes.method: Memory-tracer baseline then 20 modal mode switches
checkOutcomes.evidence: After loading the modal, 20 create/login switches increased heap from 33,591,228 to 33,786,970 bytes (0.6%) and nodes from 141,778 to 143,902 (1.5%), modest bounded growth rather than an unbounded pattern.
The loaded gate uses 4.33MB before the account/identity UI and about 33.6MB after that UI loads; the footprint is material but proportionate to the federated-login and camera-capable flow.

Neither compared heap summary reports Detached* constructors, and Object/Array populations remain nearly flat across 20 modal mode switches; no unbounded retained-listener/timer signature was observed.

principleOutcomes.reason: No developer intent or user journey indicates that this age-gated media site should expose transactional WebMCP capabilities; its public static content is already server-rendered and it exposes a conventional webmaster API. No summarisation, writing, classification, or other user task on the audited gate/legal/support paths would clearly benefit from built-in on-device inference.

paths.description: Public entry, legal age gate and account/verification overlay; primary high-risk journey.
Long-form legal/content template representing terms and similar static policy pages.
Privacy and 2257 disclosure template, reviewed for data-handling and indexing context.
Support, DMCA and takedown route representing the information-heavy two-column template.
Random nonexistent route used to inspect HTTP/error recovery behavior.

findings.summary: Hard-coded theme ignores the system color preference
findings.evidence: Dark-mode emulation and CSS inspection show no preference-driven theme mechanism.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and derive surfaces/text from prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Indefinite age-gate animation continues under reduced motion
findings.evidence: The SVG animate element repeats forever and is not covered by the existing reduced-motion rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable or replace the SMIL animation inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Primary state changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: No View Transition API or CSS was found for the gate-to-account state change.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a same-document view transition for the gate-to-account state swap, while respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Long legal pages offer no scroll-state guidance
findings.evidence: The terms page is 10,158px tall with no progress indicator or scroll-state-aware chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight declarative scroll-progress indicator to long legal documents.

findings.summary: Custom account overlay traps the user
findings.evidence: The overlay is a custom div, lacks dialog semantics and close/cancel controls, and remains after Escape.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> with an accessible name, explicit Cancel button, Escape handling, focus containment, and focus return.

findings.summary: Components only adapt at viewport breakpoints
findings.evidence: CSS probes found no container queries on reused navigation/content components.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type and component-scoped @container rules where the same components appear in different slots.

findings.summary: Many touch targets are too small
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails target-size; mobile footer links are 14px high and header icons are 30x30px.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive target boxes and spacing to at least 24x24 CSS px, preferably 44x44 for primary mobile controls.

findings.summary: Verification CTA inserts an account wall
findings.evidence: The verification action opens registration/sign-in before exposing the advertised selfie verification step.
findings.suggestedFix: Let users complete legally required age verification directly, then offer account creation as an optional later step.

findings.summary: Recovery states are missing or misleading
findings.evidence: The modal cannot be cancelled and a nonexistent URL returns HTTP 200 with the normal gate.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide modal cancel/return controls and serve a real 404 page with navigation, search and support links.

findings.summary: Entry-page LCP misses the good threshold
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 2.95s LCP on home versus the 2.5s good threshold.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP content, reduce render delay, and remeasure under mobile throttling.

findings.summary: Legacy scripts block parsing on the entry gate
findings.evidence: jQuery and ajax3.js are parser-inserted in head without async/defer; Lighthouse reports 2.16s LCP render delay.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical scripts, split the minimal gate code, and remove jQuery from the critical path where feasible.

findings.summary: Images and controls lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse finds the home logo without alt and several mobile contact header links without discernible names.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful alt/aria-label text and expose the modal as a named dialog.

findings.summary: Age-estimation status text fails contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse computes 3.83:1 for #0a910a on #222, below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a lighter green or darker background that reaches WCAG AA while preserving status meaning beyond color.

findings.summary: Entry semantics and modal focus behavior are incomplete
findings.evidence: The page lacks main/H1, has malformed list content, and the overlay lacks dialog semantics and Escape dismissal.
findings.suggestedFix: Add main and H1 landmarks, valid list markup, and native dialog focus/dismiss behavior.

findings.summary: Legal/support text is cramped
findings.evidence: Screenshots show roughly 12.5px dense justified copy, with the cookie strip overlapping mobile content.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase body size/line-height, use readable measure and left alignment, and reserve space for or remove the fixed cookie strip.

findings.summary: Image sizing and list markup are unsound
findings.evidence: All audited image elements omit intrinsic width/height and the gate list includes a BR child.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width/height or aspect-ratio to images and keep only LI children inside UL.

findings.summary: Homepage has no meta description
findings.evidence: DOM and Lighthouse confirm a title but no meta description on the public entry URL.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise, accurate age-gate meta description.

findings.summary: Canonical and 404 indexing signals are ambiguous
findings.evidence: Home has no canonical and random missing URLs return 200 with identical gate content.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a self-canonical and return HTTP 404 plus noindex for missing routes.

findings.summary: Browser defenses and cookie flags are incomplete
findings.evidence: CSP only upgrades insecure requests; nosniff and Referrer-Policy are missing; epcolor is not Secure and uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive nonce/hash CSP, nosniff, strict Referrer-Policy, a scoped Permissions-Policy, and Secure/Lax cookie flags.

findings.summary: Analytics runs before meaningful consent
findings.evidence: Piwik loads while the notice offers only [X] and treats continued use as agreement; identity iframes load after opening the flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not start optional analytics before an explicit choice; offer reject/settings and document identity-provider data transfers in context.

findings.summary: Core age verification has no no-JS path
findings.evidence: The CTA is an onclick-only button, so the primary gate cannot advance without JavaScript despite fully server-rendered copy.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a real form/action or link fallback that reaches a server-rendered verification path, then enhance it with JS.

findings.summary: Entry language and bidirectional foundations are missing
findings.evidence: The entry HTML lacks lang/dir and audited CSS uses no logical properties, despite localized legal templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the correct lang and dir on every response and migrate directional layout to logical properties.

findings.summary: Verification and consent disclosures are not transparent
findings.evidence: The gate does not disclose the account detour or biometric/third-party choices, and the cookie strip lacks reject/settings.
findings.suggestedFix: Disclose verification steps and processors before the CTA, separate required verification from optional account creation, and use explicit granular consent.

findings.summary: Sign-in fields block autofill assistance
findings.evidence: The login input is autocomplete=off and password/login controls lack correct autocomplete tokens.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=username and autocomplete=current-password, preserving password-manager and passkey affordances.

findings.summary: Decorative and thumbnail assets use avoidable legacy delivery
findings.evidence: The gate uses a 169KB JPEG background and GIF badge; contact uses legacy JPEG thumbnails and no intrinsic dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Encode raster assets as AVIF/WebP where beneficial and supply intrinsic dimensions/responsive sources.

findings.summary: Support page fetches invisible media
findings.evidence: The contact template downloads gallery thumbnails whose rendered size is 0x0, plus analytics before consent.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not request gallery media on support/legal templates; conditionally load optional analytics only after consent.

taskList.title: Replace the custom trapped account overlay with a dismissible native dialog and remove the mandatory account detour
Fix accessible names, landmarks, contrast, target sizes and reading typography
Require explicit analytics consent and harden CSP, security headers and cookies
Provide a progressively enhanced verification route and real 404 recovery
Defer legacy scripts and reduce entry-page LCP render delay
Add preference-driven theming and reduced-motion handling
Stop loading invisible gallery media and modernise image delivery
Repair metadata, language and autocomplete signals
